models.title: Leverage-weighted balance-sheet change (bank/insurer)
models.summary: Equity percentage change as leverage-scaled asset change minus leverage-scaled liability change.

relationship.locator: PDF: LM5 Bank and Insurer Model, Eq3 with Exhibits 22/23, printed pp. 376-377 (PDF pp. 386-387)
relationship.translation_notes: Solved for dE/E so the record outputs the equity change. Decimals throughout (unit 1). By Eq1 (A = L + E over E), le = lev - 1 when inputs are consistent; the record keeps both leverage inputs independently auditable instead of enforcing this.

variables.definition: Percentage change in market value of assets, decimal

assumptions: Market-value inputs; E = A - L identity holds (per corroborated source).
limitations: First-order accounting decomposition only: small overall changes over short intervals; no convexity, embedded options, or non-parallel moves (PDF footnote 10). Book-value leverage misstates the magnification.

sources.title: Duration Gap Analysis (RiskHub)
sources.locator: Derivation: E = A - L, dE = dA - dL; DGAP = DA - k*DL; dE ~ -DGAP*A*dy; A/E typically 10-15x so a 2-year gap is a 20-30% equity swing per 1% move.

models.title: Modified duration value-impact approximation
models.summary: First-order percentage value change as negative modified duration times the yield change.

relationship.locator: PDF: LM5 Bank and Insurer Model, Eq7 modified duration definition, printed p. 379 (PDF p. 389)
relationship.translation_notes: Solved for the value change dW/W = -DW**dr; written (0-dur*dr) for grammar safety. Duration plays the years role only via dr in decimals: years x decimal yield change = decimal value change.

variables.definition: Modified duration of the value, in years
Change in yield, decimal
Approximate percentage change in value, decimal

assumptions: Small parallel yield shift; cash flows independent of rates.
limitations: First-order only; breaks for large moves, non-parallel shifts, and rate-dependent cash flows (embedded options). PDF footnote 10 reiterates convexity/options are not captured.

models.title: Equity volatility of a leveraged bank/insurer
models.summary: Variance of equity percentage value changes from leverage-weighted asset/liability variances and their correlation.

relationship.locator: PDF: LM5 Bank and Insurer Model, Eq9 with Example 8 Foresight, printed pp. 381-385 (PDF pp. 391-395)
relationship.translation_notes: Record outputs the variance exactly as Eq9 is stated (unit 1, decimal-squared); sigma = sqrt(output) per Example 8 (sqrt(0.06) = 24.5%, sqrt(0.038125) = 19.5%, sqrt(0.025225) = 15.9% for Q3). The PDF's footnote 12 states the Var(aX+bY) property used to transform Eq4 into Eq9. Rho bounded [-1,1] by correlation definition.

variables.definition: Leverage ratio, assets to equity, decimal

Correlation between asset and liability percentage value changes
Variance of shareholder equity percentage value changes, decimal-squared

assumptions: Eq4 linear structure with constant leverage weights and stable volatilities/correlation; standard deviations share one horizon.
limitations: Correlations break down in turbulent markets (PDF: divergence raises equity volatility dramatically at high leverage). Exhibit 26 curves are graphical context, not a formula.
